title: Seedling Swap turns five as Fernhaven Seed Library blossoms
text: Fernhaven's quayside was crowded on Saturday for the fifth annual Seedling Swap, the Fernhaven Seed Library's spring festival. Founded in 2014 by retired schoolteacher Maren Odell, the library lends packets of vegetable and flower seed free of charge from the converted lifeboat station on Quay Street, asking borrowers to return seed saved from their harvest at the end of the season. Volunteers spent the morning handing out trays of seedlings and signing up new members, and Odell said the swap gets bigger every year.
